about.intro_content: Prof. Ji-Hong Liu is Director of the Department of Gynecologic Oncology at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center (SYSUCC), Guangzhou, and has practised gynecologic oncology at SYSUCC for over 30 years.
about.detailed_content: Prof. Liu led the PHENIX trial, a practice-changing study on sentinel lymph node biopsy alone versus biopsy with lymphadenectomy in cervical cancer, published in the New England Journal of Medicine in 2025. She has also contributed to a genome-wide association study identifying cervical cancer susceptibility loci, published in Nature Genetics. Her research spans human papillomavirus infection, molecular phenotyping of ovarian carcinoma, chemoresistance, and lymph node metastasis in gynecologic malignancies. She previously served as Vice-President of SYSUCC and Director of its Clinical Study Center (2004–2008).

faq.section_heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Prof. Ji-Hong Liu

items.question: Does Prof. Ji-Hong Liu accept international patients?
items.answer: CancerFax can coordinate medical report review and consultation support for international patients seeking an opinion related to cervical or ovarian cancer at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center, subject to hospital availability and case acceptance.

items.question: What is Prof. Liu's area of specialisation?
items.answer: Prof. Liu specialises in the surgical treatment of cervical and ovarian cancer, with a particular research focus on lymph node staging and metastasis.

items.question: How can I request a consultation or second opinion?
items.answer: Submit your medical reports through CancerFax. The CancerFax team reviews the documents, prepares the case for submission, and coordinates next steps with SYSUCC's International Medical Center, subject to availability.

items.question: What is the PHENIX trial and why does it matter?
items.answer: The PHENIX trial, led by Prof. Liu and published in the New England Journal of Medicine (2025), compared sentinel lymph node biopsy alone against biopsy with full lymphadenectomy in early-stage cervical cancer, informing less invasive staging approaches.

items.question: Is Prof. Liu involved in ongoing clinical trials?
items.answer: Yes. Prof. Liu is Principal Investigator on active trials evaluating lymph node staging approaches in both cervical and early ovarian cancer.
